تستحصلن (form X)
# تَسْتَحْصِلْنَ (tastaḥṣilna) /tas.taħ.sˤil.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْصَلَ (istaḥṣala)
# تُسْتَحْصَلْنَ (tustaḥṣalna) /tus.taħ.sˤal.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْصَلَ (istaḥṣala)
